request: Staff can record a bank-transfer expense from their phone in under 30 seconds, and the accountant sees it in Odoo without asking in WhatsApp. Context: MRH Investment (Maldives, shop + warehouse + wholesale, MVR). Different staff pay different expenses and the accountant asks in a WhatsApp group for each amount. Odoo (mrh-investment.odoo.com, saas-19.4) holds expenses as hr.expense, but 31 of 36 records have no receipt, 20 of 36 use the generic category 'Expenses', and some sit in draft, so totals are wrong. Staff have no Odoo logins and will not use Odoo screens. Jobs: Staff - record the transfer I just made, fast, on my phone, with the receipt if I have it. Accountant - see what was spent, by category and day, without asking. Owner/manager - keep bad entries out of the books (a person submits and approves drafts in Odoo).

values.observation: V1 Expenses pane with dummy data: ike-sales gains a third tab 'Expenses', reached by swipe and by the tab bar like Sales and Quotations, plum accent, ids and classes scoped to the pane; it shows the day's confirmed total, a separate pending line, the category list and the day's entries with chips 'Waiting to send', 'Not sent' (with next retry time and Retry), 'Draft', 'Approved' and 'Refused'; the Add sheet takes amount (MVR), one of the 21 categories, an optional receipt from camera or gallery, and the PIN; on a phone it matches design/expenses-tab/ in light and dark (with the D12 words); it makes no network call; an entry added on the sheet appears in the list as 'Waiting to send'; Sales and Quotations behave as before.

V2 Save-first service: a Cloudflare Worker with D1 answers 'saved' for an entry (amount, category, optional receipt, PIN, client entry id) only after the entry and its receipt are stored durably; it refuses a wrong PIN, a request from any origin other than the ike-sales page, an unknown category, and an amount that is not a positive MVR number, and it rate-limits wrong PINs; the same client entry id sent twice stores one entry, not two; it serves the 21 categories and the day's entries with their status; the PIN is a Worker secret, and a changed secret takes effect at once without touching saved entries.

V3 Pane on real data: the Expenses pane takes its 21 categories and the day's entries with status from the service, and the day's confirmed total, pending total and category list from ike-data/data/expenses.json; 'Post expense' on a phone saves through the service, closes the sheet and shows the entry as 'Waiting to send', inside the 30-second budget; a wrong PIN or an unreachable service keeps the typed entry in the sheet with a plain message, and the page never shows an entry as saved that the service did not confirm.

values.observation: V4 Odoo sync: for each saved entry the Worker creates exactly one DRAFT hr.expense (employee Ahmed Rashad id 1, the chosen category, the amount in MVR, company-paid by bank transfer, dated per D16, the receipt attached when given, and a unique mark naming the entry) and never submits, approves, posts or pays it; a failed or unanswered Odoo call leaves the entry saved as 'Not sent' with its next retry time, it retries on schedule and on Retry, and a retry after a create whose answer was lost finds the existing expense by its mark instead of creating a second; once created the entry shows 'Draft' and appears as pending in expenses.json; the Odoo API key exists only as a Worker secret.
dependencies: V2 Save-first service: a Cloudflare Worker with D1 answers 'saved' for an entry (amount, category, optional receipt, PIN, client entry id) only after the entry and its receipt are stored durably; it refuses a wrong PIN, a request from any origin other than the ike-sales page, an unknown category, and an amount that is not a positive MVR number, and it rate-limits wrong PINs; the same client entry id sent twice stores one entry, not two; it serves the 21 categories and the day's entries with their status; the PIN is a Worker secret, and a changed secret takes effect at once without touching saved entries.

values.observation: V5 Status read-back: every 15 minutes, on the same Worker schedule as the sync retries, the Worker reads the Odoo state of its entries that still show 'Draft' with one read-only call and sets each chip by D12: draft or submitted stays 'Draft', approved/posted/in_payment/paid becomes 'Approved', refused becomes 'Refused'; an entry in Approved or Refused is not read again; an Odoo failure during read-back changes no chip and is tried again on the next run; the Worker writes nothing to Odoo in this step.

values.observation: V6 Live with the owner: the Worker is deployed on Cloudflare with its 15-minute schedule and the page on GitHub Pages; the owner records one real bank-transfer expense from a phone in under 30 seconds; the accountant finds it in Odoo as a draft hr.expense with the right category, amount and receipt without asking; after a person approves it in Odoo its chip shows 'Approved' within one schedule interval; the owner changes the PIN once in the Cloudflare dashboard, the new PIN saves and the old PIN is refused.
